source.title: GVP Module VI Addendum II — masking personal data in EudraVigilance ICSRs
source.origin: Supplied copy matched byte-for-byte against the official EMA download.
source.attribution: © European Medicines Agency and Heads of Medicines Agencies, 2025. Source acknowledged; original source governs.

summary: The addendum defines destination-specific masking/blank/preservation groups for EudraVigilance ICSR submissions. Available data in 13 listed fields use MSK; 11 other fields are left blank. Available fields in the two preservation tables remain available under their applicable implementation guidance. Company current controls, applicability and implementation gaps remain unconfirmed.

requirements.proposal: Determine all company and partner EudraVigilance sender responsibilities and clinical/marketed scope.
requirements.acceptance: An approved scope matrix identifies each sender, destination and excluded jurisdiction.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Apply the 13-field conditional MSK policy only to confirmed EudraVigilance outbound mappings.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic available/unavailable branches produce reviewer-approved output for all 13 fields.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Omit or leave blank the 11 Table 2 fields according to the applicable XML specification; do not use unsupported nullFlavors.
requirements.acceptance: All 11 outputs are inspected with exact omission semantics and negative tests.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Preserve available Table 3–4 data under the applicable implementation guidance and established pseudonymisation controls.
requirements.acceptance: Clinical content, identifiers and technical metadata are not lost through blanket masking.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Verify destination routing, local customizations, partner transformations and report-form confidentiality options independently.
requirements.acceptance: EudraVigilance rules cannot unintentionally change other destinations; actual XML is verified.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Document a reasonable implementation timeframe and how the sender will achieve it in internal procedures.
requirements.acceptance: Regulatory/QA approves the recorded plan and rationale; the effect date is not converted into an invented fixed grace deadline.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Perform schema/business-rule checks plus explicit masking checks; a gateway ACK alone is insufficient evidence of the masking policy.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic field assertions, ACK checks and regression evidence are retained and reviewed.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Maintain controlled source records, vendor/partner agreements, SOPs and controlled change history.
requirements.acceptance: Relevant procedures and responsibilities are revised and attributable.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Train case processors, reporting operations, systems support, QA and relevant partners on field groups and exceptions.
requirements.acceptance: Role-based training and practical acceptance evidence are approved.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

requirements.proposal: Implement through company change control with backup, rollback, independent review and post-change verification.
requirements.acceptance: An authorized reviewer confirms evidence and closure; source records are retained without deleting master case data.
requirements.basis: PV Info implementation inference; not wording imposed by the regulator.

tests.expected: Represent available synthetic data using MSK; confirm the precise XML form against the applicable IG.
Use only permitted alternative nullFlavor/blank behavior; do not falsely assert that masked data were available.
Verify omission/blank semantics and that no unsupported nullFlavor is generated.
Check that C.2.r.2.4 and C.2.r.2.5 are preserved when available; do not apply the street/postcode rule to them.
Check that C.3.4.8 is preserved when available under its applicable guidance, unlike Table 2 sender fields.
Verify field-specific content/pseudonymisation for D.1, D.2.1 and H.1; the category does not authorize unrestricted identifying content.
Preserve required available metadata and validate syntactic compatibility.
Prove no unapproved output change for other destinations; assess their rules separately.
Verify relevant message types, repeating reporters/parents and updates without assuming legacy resubmission is required.
Prove inbound/outbound transformations cannot reintroduce omitted fields or suppress required content.
Retain ACK/business-rule evidence and independently verify all 282 listed references applicable to the test scope.
Verify rollback and independent closure evidence without deleting original case information.

unchanged: No change to EudraVigilance business rules is specified (section 1).
The EU ICSR implementation guide remains applicable (section 1).
No new 7-day/15-day reporting clock is established by this addendum.
EMA-side treatment of legacy submissions does not establish a blanket sender resubmission instruction.
unknowns: No verified pre-change requirement baseline is supplied; this is a first-capture assessment, not a proven regulatory redline.
Company products, sender responsibilities, destinations, installed system release/patches and current controls need confirmation.
Exact vendor database fields, supported masking switches, XML omission representation and local customizations have not been verified.
Table 3 preservation does not authorize unrestricted personal information; assess applicable field-level IG/pseudonymisation rules.

now: Scheduled approved-source monitoring and discovery intake
PDF capture/checksum and draft paragraph extraction
Supported EMA table-policy extraction on ingestion
Draft baseline preparation and source-linked design/test prompts
human: Register/approve newly discovered sources where required
Approve public editorial analysis before calling it reviewed/premium
Confirm company scope and current controls
Approve system design, execute validation and verify closure
limits: This supported edition recipe is not autonomous interpretation of arbitrary new guidance.
A changed or unsupported table/edition requires manual review.
No paid LLM/API, live vendor connection, patient XML or auto-approval is used.
The source is historical; publication in July 2025 is not represented as detection by PV Info at that time.
Twice-daily news refresh is separate from bounded document monitoring; immediate detection is not guaranteed.
